findings.title: Commits and PR body carry Claude/Anthropic attribution trailers, violating user's global…
findings.claim: Commits 0276a66 and 78891dd carry 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context)' trailers, and the PR body ends with a 'Generated with Claude Code' line; the reviewer says the user's global instructions forbid both and both commits and the PR description must be edited before merge.

findings.title: Nested vector element type prints as bare prefix in new error message, dropping inner…
findings.claim: Because VectorType has no String(), the new error reads 'no Go type for element type custom(org.apache.cassandra.db.marshal.VectorType)' and drops the inner type and dimension; adding a VectorType.String() would fix this and the pre-existing 'can not unmarshal %s into %T' messages too.

findings.title: Bound-check error message omits the per-element minimum for nested element types
findings.claim: For a nested element type, the message '3 dimensions do not fit in 24 bytes' looks wrong to anyone unaware of the element minimum; the reviewer suggests printing elemMin alongside.

findings.title: PR body's claim that every new test fails on pristine code is overstated
findings.claim: TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType actually pass on the base commit; they're fine as guard tests but the PR body should say so rather than claiming every new test fails.

findings.title: Commit 0276a66's message undersells the change it actually makes
findings.claim: The commit body says 'every element takes at least one byte on the wire', but the commit actually introduces the type-aware floor via vectorElemMinSize; the PR description is accurate but the commit body is not.

findings.title: Allocation-ceiling test is environment-sensitive and may flake from leaked goroutine…
findings.claim: The 128 KB TotalAlloc delta check can absorb allocations from goroutines leaked by earlier tests; it passed under -race in this run but the flake surface is being flagged.

findings.title: Bound check verified to precede every Dimensions consumer without overflow risk
findings.claim: The reviewer verified the bound sits ahead of every Dimensions consumer (both float fast paths, reflect.MakeSlice, the array-length check, and the len(data)/Dimensions derivation), that Dimensions > len(data)/elemMin cannot overflow, negatives are rejected first, and elemMin is floored at 1 and saturates at MaxInt32.

findings.title: vectorElemMinSize verified correct across all element type kinds with no infinite…
findings.claim: The reviewer verified vectorElemMinSize is right for fixed, variable-length, tuple, UDT, collection, unknown custom, and nested vector element types, and cannot recurse infinitely.

findings.title: Nil-Go-type guard verified as the only dereference site; marshal direction has no…
findings.claim: The reviewer verified the nil-Go-type guard is at the only dereference site, and that marshalVector never calls Zero() and enforces dim == len(v) before allocating, so the marshal direction has no equivalent crash.

findings.title: getCassandraLongType change verified to not affect callers relying on old empty…
findings.claim: The reviewer verified the getCassandraLongType change only alters the custom string of types that were already TypeCustom, and no caller depends on the old empty value.

findings.claim: The behavior of a *any destination yielding []*float32 is deferred/pre-existing and was not investigated as part of this review.

findings.title: Seven unrelated TLS test failures from missing testdata/pki certs set aside as out of…
findings.claim: Seven unrelated TLS test failures occur from missing testdata/pki certs when running the whole package without make test-unit; these are pre-existing and were not investigated as part of this review.
